verdict.rationale: Godot's own docs describe a Node and Scene system for composing anything (godot-docs-6) and an editor that saves and loads scenes and lets you inspect and edit resources and objects (godot-docs-22). Assets are managed through the editor's FileSystem dock (godot-docs-28), and editor plugins can be built from standard scenes (godot-docs-4), so scene composition and inspector-style editing are first-party. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the 2D/3D viewport and level-building workflow, documentation of reusable scene instancing as a prefab equivalent, and independent hands-on corroboration from technical artists.
